source_lod_contract: 27 source models and 45 placements inventoried across HIGH/LOW/ZERO on Brands Hatch, Croft, Knockhill and Snetterton. Improve only 13 HIGH model bindings at 28 original placements; lower-detail source models, omissions, hierarchy, roots and selection remain unchanged.
source_uv_limitations: Some source bodies reuse one flank photograph through mirrored opposite-side UVs. Existing UVs and slots remain unchanged, so reconstructed lettering is reversed on that original mirrored side; no separate side material was added.
static_exception: Stationary FREE service/road vehicles without Car actor, wheel rotation, steering or damage. Original source proportions and photo tyre footprints govern these forms; touring-car wheel dimensions do not apply. LCAR1 is a double-sided parked-car photo row and remains exact 4V/4T.
